newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler denies report Schrempp gave H2 profit.
newsitem.headline: Daimler denies report Schrempp gave H2 profit.

text.p: A spokesman at Daimler-Benz AG denied on Wednesday a press report that Chairman Juergen Schrempp had put the group's net profit in the second half of 1996 at 850 million marks.
"No specific number was given," the spokesman said. "Schrempp only repeated previous statements that the second half of 1996 would be better than the first half."
Net profits in the first six months of 1996 were 782 million marks, up from a loss of 1.6 billion marks in the first half of 1995.
Daimler will hold its annual press conference on April 16.
